name: The Same Coin
source:
It's been a year since Dexter and Shirley have started their relationship; and on their first anniversary, they are revealing their true selves that enable them to love each other more.

[From [URL=https://dagitabsoft.itch.io/the-same-coin]Itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
德克斯特与雪莉已经交往一年了。在一周年纪念日这天，他们向彼此展露真实的自己，也因此更加深爱对方。

[摘自[URL=https://dagitabsoft.itch.io/the-same-coin]itch.io[/URL]]
